title: Verify recovery of a pending recipe step
changes: Document real-session recovery after terminating a recipe client while its mutating frame step was pending.
validation: In an isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter, a status query confirmed the 60-frame request and its exact ID pending before the owned client was terminated. Explicit resume kept the ID, completed exactly 60 frames and the following one-frame step, and a second resume preserved frame, clock, registers, keys and state hash. Protected inputs were unchanged and the GUI closed normally.

An initial 600-frame attempt exceeded the fixed 120-second deadline and returned unconfirmed; a separate 60-frame launch encountered another owner’s Wine lease and started no test. Both diagnostics were retained; the passing run followed lease release.
limitations: This covers one interrupted client and live control run, not a runtime/session restart, native Windows, physical input or broader action types. Private session copies are retained as the current pending-step proof pending replacement.
